mechanism_claims.claim_text: ECP32-41 internalization is dependent on cell-surface GAGs, especially heparan sulfate proteoglycans.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: ECP32-41 in Beas-2B and CHO cell models

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=8:Effect of HS on ECP32-41 Internalization; xml:fig=2:Figure 2; xml:fig=3:Figure 3

mechanism_claims.limitations: The evidence supports GAG/HSPG-mediated uptake in tested cell systems; it does not define a single protein receptor.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: At low concentration, ECP32-41 uptake is temperature- and energy-dependent and is mainly routed through lipid-raft endocytosis/macropinocytosis with actin dependence.

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=10:ECP32-41 Internalization via Lipid-raft Dependent Endocytosis and Macropinocytosis; xml:fig=4:Figure 4

mechanism_claims.limitations: Chemical inhibitor data support pathway involvement but do not quantify exact pathway fractions beyond the source-reported reductions.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: ECP32-41 itself is not detectably cytotoxic or membrane-disruptive in Beas-2B cells under the reported MTT and LDH assays.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Negative toxicity conclusion is limited to the reported concentration range, cell line, and 24 h exposure.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: ECP32-41 can deliver cargoes including eGFP and the KLA peptidomimetic cargo into cells; KLA-ECP32-41 cytotoxicity is reduced by heparin/chondroitin sulfate competition.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: ECP32-41 cargo delivery and KLA-ECP32-41 in Beas-2B cells
